source.transcription: RGB values manually transcribed from printed colour labels by the japanesecolors project.
source.relationship: japanesecolors is an independent, unaffiliated project. It is not associated with, licensed by, endorsed by or approved by SendPoints. This file contains transcribed colour values and project metadata only - no text, page layouts, photographs, advertisements or other artwork from the book.

collections.method: Manual transcription of printed RGB labels; hexadecimal values calculated from RGB. No photographic color sampling or CMYK conversion.
collections.color_space_assumption: Printed RGB triplets are treated as sRGB for web/R use; no color profile is specified in the supplied photographs.
collections.names_note: Stable IDs and descriptive names are editorial additions, not official palette names. Retro display names are editorial additions by this project, not official design names.
collections.review_note: Transcribed means visually readable in the supplied photo, not independently verified against a publisher source. Review entries contain provisional candidate values, not certified transcriptions.

dataviz.method: Minimum pairwise CIEDE2000 distance within each palette, measured in normal vision and under simulated deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia (Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes 2009, severity 1.0), plus the closest approach of any colour to white. Thresholds are calibrated so that the Okabe-Ito palette, designed for colour-vision deficiency, passes.
dataviz.note: dataviz_friendly is a screening aid, not a guarantee. It judges categorical separability only, and says nothing about whether a palette suits a given chart, audience or medium.
